<p class="MsoNormal"><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The residential units, by reason of their poor outlook onto the side alley wall and rear service yards to the west; inadequate natural light to the habitable rooms on the ground
floor unit; lack of outdoor private amenity space; security concerns by virtue
of their context, access and lack of Secure by Design features; and highly insufficient
ceiling would result in a substandard form of accommodation for future
occupiers of the site to the detriment of their living conditions. The
development is thereby contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the
National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3, D6 and D12 of The
London Plan (2021), Policies DM1 and DM2 of the Harrow Development Management
Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Documents
Residential Design Guide (2010).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">In the absence of the required Flood Risk Assessment,
occupier safety information and sustainable drainage measures, the high risk of
un-mitigated surface water flooding in this critical drainage area is considered
unacceptable and contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policy
DM9 of the DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013)
and Policy SI12 of London Plan (2023).<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></p>

<p>The lack of any cycle storage details, or obvious location for their placement, would not provide sufficient support for active and sustainable travel, nor help mitigate the development’s additional impacts on the local highway network and parking, contrary to Policy DM42&nbsp; of the Development Management Policies Local Plan 2013; Policy T5 of the London Plan (2021) and the National Planning Policy Framework (2023).</p><div><br></div>

<p>In the
absence of supporting information or justification, the proposals are not
considered to provide sufficient waste storage and servicing space for the retained
commercial unit, contrary to Policy DM45 &nbsp;of the Development Management Policies Local
Plan 2013; Policy T7 of the London Plan (2021) and the National Planning Policy
Framework (2023).<br></p>
description: Construction of two storey building comprising of two flats (2 X 2 bed) (partially retrospective)
